{{Top|leg}}
This '''rental bay''' was located in the [[Elmas private spaceport]], outside of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. After the [[assassination attempt on Wedge Antilles]] [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran]], [[Mirax Terrik Horn|Mirax]], [[Iella Wessiri Antilles|Iella]], [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge]], and [[Myri Antilles|Myri]] prepared the ''[[Pulsar Skate]]'', and the [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]] of Wedge and Corran in this bay. The windows were blacked out, in an attempt to stay hidden. When [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] was pursuing [[Han Solo/Legends|Han]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]], and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando]], both groups decided to leave Corellia together.
